newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares tumble, seen friendly next week.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares tumble, seen friendly next week.

text.p: Austrian shares eased on Friday dragged down by profit-taking and dollar weakness, but traders said the fact that the ATX ended above 1,430 meant the outlook for next week should be positive.
The 21 blue chip ATX index dropped 32.33 points or 2.21 percent to 1,432.67. Among its constituents 18 losers outweighed three gainers.
Traders voiced surprise at the extent of the losses.

"We expected a weaker market in the morning, but were a bit surprised that it went down so far," said one trader. Dollar and bond losses were cited as key reasons for the decline. The DAX and FTSE both ended over one percent down.
However, traders took some consolation in the fact that the index closed above support at 1,430. The next support level is seen at 1,408 points.
Wall Street developments and the expiry of August futures and options were the main factors likely to affect the market next week, traders said.
The top gainer was brewer BBAG, up two percent at 806.65 schillings.
Steelmaker VA Stahl led the losers, down 6.56 percent at 578 schillings.
The August ATX future slipped 42.10 points to 1,428.20.
